python3 - <<'PY'
import openpyxl, sys
filename='/app/PeriodRate.xlsx'
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(filename)
ws=wb.active
# find first numeric column
header=[cell.value for cell in ws[1]]
# assume second column numeric
col_idx=2
values=[ws.cell(row=r, column=col_idx).value for r in range(2, ws.max_row+1)]
period_rates=[]
for i in range(1,len(values)):
    prev=values[i-1]
    curr=values[i]
    if prev and prev!=0:
        rate=(curr-prev)/prev*100
    else:
        rate=None
    period_rates.append(rate)
# add header
if 'Period Rate (%)' not in header:
    ws.cell(row=1, column=ws.max_column+1, value='Period Rate (%)')
col=ws.max_column
for r,rate in enumerate(period_rates, start=2):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=col, value=rate)
# find max
max_rate=max([r for r in period_rates if r is not None])
for r,rate in enumerate(period_rates, start=2):
    if rate==max_rate:
        cell=ws.cell(row=r, column=col)
        cell.font=openpyxl.styles.Font(color='00ff00')
wb.save(filename)
print('done')
PY
